verdict.rationale: Rootly documents status pages, including private ones, for communicating service health to internal stakeholders. Its workflow automation lists "stakeholders updated" as a standard response step, and AI generates structured status write-ups from the incident record, so stakeholders can stay informed outside the incident channel. However, no evidence shows a subscribe mechanism (email, Slack or other notification opt-in) for internal stakeholders, which is a key part of the story. Missing for 10: documented stakeholder subscription/opt-in notifications, detail on the structure and cadence of stakeholder update templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
